Animation in Unreal Engine

  • Class 01: Character Animation in UE 5.8
  • Class 02: Creating Animated Cinematics

Learn how to animate characters, props, and more in the industry’s most in-demand software! It’s time to add Unreal Engine 5 to your resume.

Class series overview

What we’ll cover in this series:

  • Level Sequences

    • Project Structures Explained In-Depth
    • Sequencer for Animation
    • Animation Shot Setup

  • Animation Sequences

    • Layered Control Rigs
    • Baking / Reverse-Solving Animation
    • Linked Animation Sequences

  • Shot Setup + Cameras

    • Project Organization for Indie / Teams
    • Cameras & Subsequences
    • Exporting / Movie Render Queue

  • Control Rig Animation

    • Keyframe Animation Features & Tools
    • Animation Layers & UE Workflows
    • Creating Control Rig Characters

  • Curve Editor + Anim Tools

    • Pose Library, Temp Pivot, Tweener, etc.
    • Curve Editor Tools & Shortcuts
    • Quality of Life Settings & Features

  • Constraints + Deformers

    • Constraints / Space Switching
    • Control Rig Utilities & Deformers
    • Rig Dynamics & Real-Time Physics

  • Maya to Unreal Animation

    • Maya Character Setup / Templates
    • Animation Export & FBX Import
    • Alembic / USD Rendering Workflows

  • Motion Capture Workflow

    • Animation Retargeting
    • Mocap Cleanup / Anim Layering
    • Nondestructive Real-Time Workflows

  • Anim Blueprint Basics

    • Additional Animation Methods
    • Blend Spaces / Take Recorder
    • Character Blueprints Overview
